title: Isolation and Culture of Primary Human Gingival Epithelial Cells using Y-27632
protocol: Collect fresh adult gingival tissues in 15 mL tubes containing 10 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) supplemented with 3% penicillin/streptomycin (P/S).
Keep the tissues at 4°C.
Mix 50 mL of PBS with 1.5 mL of penicillin and 1.5 mL of streptomycin to prepare a washing solution.
Dissolve 125 mg of Dispase powder and 125 mg of Type I collagenase powder in 50 mL of DMEM.
Filter the enzyme solutions through a 0.22 μm strainer.
Store the filtered enzyme solutions at 4°C.
Prepare 500 mL of medium to neutralize enzymatic digestion with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1% P/S in DMEM.
Wash gingival tissue with 5 mL of 75% ethanol for 30 s.
Rinse twice with 5 mL of washing solution for 5 min.
Cut the gingival tissue into 1 mm³ pieces.
Scatter the cut tissue pieces in a 100 mm cell culture dish.
Add G-medium to the culture dish.
Incubate the culture dish in a 5% CO₂ incubator at 37 °C.
Examine the tissues every 24 h using an inverted microscope (40x).
Remove gingival tissue pieces when epithelial cells have propagated to a 2-5 mm diameter around the tissue pieces.
Change G-medium every 2-4 days.
Follow the same steps as described for the direct explant method, step 3.1.1, for pretreatment of gingival tissue.
Cut the gingival tissue into tiny pieces, approximately <1 mm in size, with two sterilized blades.
Shred the tissue again using two surgical blades.
Add 1 mL of 2.5 mg/mL dispase + collagenase solution to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube containing the tissue pieces.
Incubate the tube for 15-20 min in an incubator at 37 °C.
Add 1 mL of neutralization solution to terminate the digestion when tissue becomes transparent and flocculent.
Thoroughly mix the solution by pipetting up and down 10-15 times.
Pass the solution through a 100 µm mesh filter.
Centrifuge at 200 x g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL of growth-factor-containing medium.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 100 mm cell culture dish.
Add 10 µM of Y-27632 to the cell culture dish.
Culture the cells at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Replace the old G-medium with fresh G-medium every 2 days.
Observe the cells on Day 1 and Day 3.
Take the dish out of the incubator, remove spent medium, and wash twice with PBS.
Add 2 mL of 0.05% trypsin for each 100 mm dish.
Shake the dish to ensure enough contact between the Trypsin solution and the dish bottom.
Leave the dish in an incubator around 5 min at 37 °C for digestion process.
Use a microscope (40x) to examine cells, ensuring most have separated from the bottom of the dish.
Add 2 mL of neutralization solution to stop the digestion and transfer cells into a 15 mL tube.
Pipette up and down 10-15 times.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 x g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant slowly.
Resuspend the cells with 10 mL of G-medium and count the number of cells.
Add about 1 x 10^6 cells in 10 mL of G-medium and 10 µM Y-27632 to each 100 mm dish.
Renew the G-medium every 2 days.
Renew Y-27632 every 2 days.
View cells on Day 1.
View cells on Day 5.
